notes.title: Tactical RPG The Protagonist: EX-1 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Experience tactical combat in this intense sci-fi RPG. After a constructive Early Access campaign, 3Mind Games’ The Protagonist: EX-1 has had a full release on Steam. With a gripping story of survival behind enemy lines, use strategy and unique hand-to-hand combat mechanics to escape your extraterrestrial prison. The fate of Terra is in your hands!

Watch the Protagonist: EX-1 trailer here: https://youtu.be/xlPiuT7zSkg

The Protagonist EX-1 combines RPG and turn-based strategy elements with a gripping science fiction story to keep players entertained for hours. Personalise your campaign as you control Angel and the squad, customising their close-combat abilities and navigating through dynamic dialogue trees, where decisions can have drastic consequences! With characters voiced by an impressive cast, including Hollywood actors Temuera Morrison and Tony Todd, delve into a narrative of war, mystery and extra-terrestrial action as you defeat menacing alien foes and control the fate of the world below you.

[b]Full release notes: [/b]

- All Playable Characters (10+)
- All Playable Areas 
- Bugs fixes

notes.title: New Level, New Playable Character & Additional Enemies
notes.content:
Hello Terran’s, we squashed some bugs and added a new level, enjoy! 
Fixes: 

* Integration of a new level, Stage 05 (Sweet Emotion)
* Fixed Dialogues GS bug in French version of the game
* Fix Blocking Walkthrough in Stage 03
* Update Puzzle in Stage 02
* Fix a part of the level in Stage 01
* Fix Quest that doesn't Update Correctly in Stage 02
* Update Trigger Quest in Stage 04
* Credits (Fade in added)
* Fix a dialogue in Stage 01
* Fix some dialogues in the HUB
* Add free pistol to Angel in the crafting tutorial
* Fix a bug in the action bar
* Update the Crafting Tutorial in Stage 01 with DDS in Crafting of Pilot
* Update Loadout Tutorial Text in Stage 01
* Using proper icons for the shields
* Fix Abyssal that doesn't start the Fight in Stage 01
* Fix bug if the Player Save and Reload in the middle of the Crafting Tutorial in Stage 01
* Fix Pressure Plate for the HUB
* Fix Possible Bug by Saving during a Tutorial Pop UP in Stage 01l
* Modified original min distance when determining closest enemy. It is now infinity.
* Update Blocking for the Unstable Wall in Stage 01 to Stage 05
* Fix Cinematic and Character Spawn in Stage 03
* Fix Quest for the Crazed Soldier in Stage 03
* Update Dialogue for Stage 04 of the Crazy Soldier Path
* Fix Grunt that doesn't move in Stage 05
* Fix graphic bug on Convicts
* Fix Level Arts in Stage 01 and 03
* Fix Collision of the Wall in Stage 05
* Update the Quest in Stage 04
* Updated the character info of the Abyssal
